text:
Maya: Quick sync — need to lock down observability scope for the next console release. Customers keep asking for per-route cost breakdown + tracing hooks. I sketched must-have vs nice-to-have and a simple acceptance checklist.
Jason: Agree we should prioritize per-route cost and error aggregation first. Those unblock most customers' billing & SRE questions.
Li: +1. Also need to call out data retention/cost tradeoffs. Full traces forever is non-starter.
Samir: We should define a sampling model up front. Proposed: tail-sampling for errors, probabilistic for success traces.
Elaine: Can we get an estimate for infra cost if we keep 30d full traces vs 7d? Ops needs numbers for budgeting.
Maya: Rough numbers: 30d ~= 3x 7d for storage and indexing. I'll ask infra for a precise delta, but use 3x as a working assumption.
Jason: For launch MVP I propose this split:
- Must-have: per-route token cost heatmap, aggregated error counts by route & error-class, minimal trace ingestion with error-tail capture, basic dashboard tiles.
- Nice-to-have: flamegraphs in UI, full distributed trace search, per-token cost drilldown to function calls.
Li: My concern: "per-route token cost heatmap" requires adding token attribution at the gateway. That touches request path.
Samir: We can start by approximating attribution from route config + sampling. Implementation plan:
```
1) attach route_id header at ingress
2) accumulate token counts in dataplane counters
3) send periodic aggregates to telemetry pipeline
``` 
Elaine: That sounds safe. Are there privacy/regulatory flags? Some enterprise customers want token-level breakdown disabled.
Maya: Add a tenancy flag: telemetry.token_attribution = on/off. Default off for Private deployments.
Jason: Acceptance criteria for each must-have (proposal):
- Per-route cost: dashboard tile shows last 7d cost, 95th, and change vs prev period. Unit test: compare to billing export within 5%.
- Error aggregation: show top 10 error classes by route; clicking class shows sample traces (sampled) and regen steps.
- Trace hooks: SDK + gateway hook that forwards trace_id and route_id. Install tested in staging with 2 services.
Li: Rollout plan: behind feature flag, canary to 10% orgs, monitor ingestion qps and storage.
Samir: Sampling config example we can use:
```
{"error_capture": "always", "success_sample_rate": 0.05, "tail_window_ms": 5000}
```
Maya: UX asks: compact dashboard with small multiple charts per-route; we need a product mock to finalize tile sizes. @Elaine can you get a quick figma by Friday?
Elaine: Yep, will push a mock. Will include a compact table + sparkline.
Jason: Dev effort estimate (very rough): per-route cost + backend aggregation 3w, dashboard + UX 2w, trace hook SDK + ingestion 2w, canary/rollout/QA 1w => 8w total.
Maya: OK, need to prioritize scope cuts if we can't commit 8w. What if we cut "click-to-drilldown sample traces" from launch and show only top-n links to traces in a separate page?
Li: That cuts ~1w from frontend and 1w from backend. Acceptable.
Samir: Also consider storage optimization: compressed indexing + TTL for non-error traces. Could reduce infra cost by ~40%.
Elaine: We'll include a launch note describing sampling behavior and retention defaults for customers.
Jason: Risks to call out in RFC: SDK adoption lag, attribution inaccuracies for composite routes, storage costs.
Maya: Customer ask prioritization: we have 3 pilot customers pushing per-route billing visibility; if they sign proof-of-concept, we escalate to high priority.
Samir: Telemetry pipeline note: ensure we have a schema version and transform that can backfill route_id for last 7d if needed.
ops-bot: Deploy-checklist: add feature flag `obs.per_route_cost_v1`, ensure canary toggle and ingestion rate alarms.
Maya: Next steps: I'll write a short RFC with the must-have acceptance criteria, rollout plan, and the sampling config. Team to review by EOD Wednesday.
Jason: I'll add backend tickets and a rough cost table.
Li: I'll validate privacy/tenancy toggles with security.
Elaine: Figma by Friday, will include a "what customers see" screenshot for the RFC.
Samir: I'll prototype the sampling + TTL logic on staging.
Maya: Thanks — keep comments inline on the RFC. :thumbsup:
